# The Voss Case

> An AI-driven detective interrogation game. Interrogate Elias Voss, the only suspect in the disappearance of Mara Ellison.

## Introduction

The Voss Case is a single-page, browser-based detective game. The player questions Elias Voss after Mara Ellison disappears from the Marlowe Bar at 22:14. Elias has a hidden emotional state of trust, stress, and suspicion that shifts with each question and presented piece of evidence. Suspect responses are generated by a local OpenAI-compatible gateway and spoken aloud using the Web Speech API.

## Key Facts

- Case: 08-VOSS. Person missing: Mara Ellison. Primary suspect: Elias Voss.
- Three recoverable pieces of evidence: an alley camera sighting (22:19), a fingerprint on Mara's phone, and a hotel keycard entry (22:46).
- Progression stages: INITIAL LEADS, EVIDENCE, CONTRADICTIONS, THEORY, CONFRONTATION.
- The game is fully client-side. It does not store API keys and communicates only with a local gateway at localhost:20128.

## Files

- app.js: game state, evidence, contradictions, LLM conversation.
- styles.css: the interrogation room and case UI theme.
- index.html: the single-page game shell.
- 404.html: custom not-found page.
- sitemap.xml: public page index.
